main_text.head: GOMARVS.
main_text.p: EST sanè, vt rectè mones, hæc doctrina Diabolica, & hærefium ac scelerum multorum origo apertissima, quòd spiritus erroris non solùm gratia spoliat, sed alibi quàm in Ecclesia, aliisque medijs quàm Christus instituit, salutem quærere docet. Nam vt alia omittam, considera quæso ecclesiæ Romanæ εὐλαθῶς ἱερουργείαν & infinitam illam superstitionem, nihil verius comperies. Hinc tanta apud vos monasticarum religionum, quibus æternæ vitæ meritum arrogatis, colluuies: tanta in ceremonijs vestris, aqua benedicta, campanis, palmarum ramis, cineribus, agnis Dei, & cæteris idololatriæ instrumentis fiducia: adeò vt illa tanquam salutis causas præter & contra Christi institutum & dignitatem extollatis, & pretiosò Christi sanguine, summo scelere, adæquetis. Quod ita vsu profano & scriptis prq-tritum est, vt non tam probatione no-stra, quàm ipsorum exstirpatione indi-geat.

page.notes: Greek phrase "εὐλαθῶς ἱερουργείαν" is a doubtful reading of the printed Greek word (approximate). Several words in the running head and first line are damaged by a blurred scan; "apertionem" and "adduce-re" read with some uncertainty. The word "pretiosò" and "vsu" are as printed. The catchword "geat." belongs to the broken word "indi-geat." and is shown only at the foot.
